Variable description: Number of items actually and voluntarily disclosed by a given firm divided by the total number of relevant items that should be disclosed86
LogAsst is measured as natural logarithm of book value of total assets for the firm j and period t.
LEVRG is measured as long-term debts divided by capital equity.
ROA refers to return on assets, and is measured as the ratio of net income to total assets for the firm j and period t.
BOSIZE is number of board members
BrdIndpe is the ratio of (non-executive) independent directors to total board size
DUALT is dummy variable; 1 if company's CEO serves as a board chairman, 0 otherwise
BLKown is percent of shares owned by the block-holders–shareholders whose ownership ≥5% of total number of shares issued.
Big4 is dummy variable, 1 if the auditor is one of the Big4, 0 otherwise.
